scholarships.name: HIGH SCHOOL SCHOLARSHIPS
scholarships.description: There are two awards in this category.

scholarships.name: High School Faculty Scholarship Award
scholarships.description: : Each school is given the opportunity to award three scholarships annually to three students based on their own criteria. The maximum award is $1,000 for courses nine months or longer; for courses under nine months, the prospective student receives $500.

scholarships.name: High School Graduate Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: : Students graduating from high school are eligible for a scholarship of $60 per month for the duration of a selected program.
